senses.gloss:
n. (पुत्)
A hell to which the childless are condemned.

f. (-का)
A small bee.
E.
पुत to go, तिका Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
Grey bonduc, (Cæsalpinia bonducella, Rox.)
f. (-का)
1 A potherb, (Basella lucida, &c.)
2 A civet or polecat.
n. (-कं)
Ordure, excrement.
E.
पूति a stink, कन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.)
2 The polecat or civet-cat.
f. (-का)
A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.)
E.
पूति a stink or purity, कन् added, and the penultimate optionally long; also पूतिक.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A son.
2 A child, in the language of the Vedas.
3 The fifth mansion from the point of conjunction of the sun, and a zodiacal sign.
f. (-त्त्री)
A daughter.
du. always, (त्त्रौ)
Son and daughter.
E.
पुत्, and त्रा to preserve, the hell, (from,) aff. क; or पूञ् to purify, aff. त्त्र; one त may be rejected in writing this word, and its derivatives, leaving पुत्र.

m. (-कः)
1 A son.
2 A son, as it were, used as a term of endearment.
3 A fabulous animal: see शरभ.
4 A rogue, a cheat.
5 A particular mountain.
6 A sort of tree.
7 A grasshopper.
f. (-त्रका or त्रिका)
A daughter.
E.
पुत्र a son, कन् pleonasm; in the feminine form the substitution of इ for the penultimate vowel is optional.

f. (-म्या)
Wish or affection for progeny.
E.
पुत्त्र, and काम्यच् aff.

m. (-वः)
A tree, from the fruit of which necklaces are made of supposed prolific efficacy, (Nagelia putranjiva, Rox.)
E.
पुत्त्र a child, and जीव life.

m. (-कः)
A plant: see the last.
E.
पुत्त्र a child, and जीव to live, aff. खश् and कन् added.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who or what confers offspring.
E.
पुत्त्र, and द what gives.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Descended from son to son.
E.
पुत्त्र, and पौत्र a grandson, खश् aff.

f. (-ता)
Perpetual descent from son to son, &c.
E.
पुत्त्रपौत्रीण, and तल् aff.

m. (-धिः)
A substitute for a son, as an adopted-son, &c.
E.
पुत्त्र, and प्रतिनिधि a substitute.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a son or offspring.
E.
पुत्त्र, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having a son or child.
E.
पुत्त्र, and वलच् aff.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)

f. (-सूः)
The mother of a son.
E.
पुत्त्र a son, and सू a parent.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A father instructed in sacred science by his son.
E.
पुत्त्र, and आचार्य्य a teacher.

m. (-दः)
One who is maintained by his son.
E.
पुत्त्र a son, अन्न food, and आद who takes.

f. (-का)
1 A daughter.
2 A doll, a puppet.
3 The cotton or pappus of the tamarisk.
E.
पुत्त्री a daughter, कन् aff.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 The son of a daughter, appointed to raise issue for her father; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law.
2 A grandson.
E.
पुत्त्रिका a daughter, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A daughter's husband.
E.
पुत्त्रिका, and भर्त्तृ husband.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of a daughter.
E.
पुत्त्रिका, and प्रसू a mother.

m. (-तः)
A daughter's son, a grandson.
E.
पुत्त्रिका, and सुत a son.

m. (-त्त्री)
The father of a son.
f. (-णी)
1 The mother of a son, or of children generally.
2 A parasite plant.
3 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
पुत्त्र a son or offspring, इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging or relating to a son, or child.
E.
पुत्त्र, and छ aff.; also पुत्त्र्य.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Wishing for a son.
E.
पुत्त्र, and क्यच् aff. or nominal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Desiring a son.
E.
पुत्त्र, and ईप्सु desirous.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A sacrifice performed for the purpose of obtaining children.
E.
पुत्त्र offspring, and इष्टि sacrifice; also with कन् added in the feminine form, पुत्त्रेष्टिका.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Resignation of property or power by a father to his son.
E.
पुत्त्र, and ऐश्वर्य्य masterhood.

mfn. (-त्त्र्यः-त्त्र्या-त्त्र्यं)
Belonging to a son, &c.
E.
पुत्त्र, and यत् aff.

f. (-री)
1 The capital of the Nāgas.
2 A name of SARASVATĪ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pure, purified.
2 Threshed, winnowed.
3 Cleaned, cleansed.
4 Speaking the truth, sincere, honest.
5 Foul smelling, stinking.
6 Guarded, defended.
n. (-तं)
Truth, speaking truth.
m. (-तः)
1 A conch shell.
2 Kusa grass.
m. du. (-तौ)
The buttocks.
E.
पू to purify, aff. क्त.

f. (-यी)
The wife of INDRA.
E.
पूतक्रतु INDRA, ङीप् aff.; in place of उ, ऐच् is inserted, and then changed before ई to आय.

m. (-तुः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
पूत pure, and क्रतु sacrifice.

m. (-द्रुः)
A tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
पूत, and द्रु a tree.

n. (-न्यं)
Sesamum.
E.
पूत, and धान्य grain.

f. (-ना)
1 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
2 The name of a female demon killed by KṚṢṆA.
3 A disease, atrophy and wasting in a child, ascribed to the malignant operations of the female fiend PŪTANĀ.
E.
पूत to be pure, nominal verb, युच् aff.

m. (-रिः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
पूतना a female fiend, and अरि the foe.

m. (-नः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
पूतना, and सूदन destroyer.

m. (-हा)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
पूतना, and हन् who kills: see the three words preceding.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Purified, freed from sin.
E.
पूत, and पाप sin.

mfn. (-प्मा-प्मा-प्म)
Purified from sin.
E.
पूत, and पाप्मन् sin.

m. (-लः)
The jack tree.
E.
पूत fetid, फल fruit.

m. (-त्मा)
1 A saint, an ascetic, a pure or purified person.
2 A man of a cleanly person, or purified by ablution.
E.
पूत purified, आत्मन् spirit or self.

f. (-तिः)
1 Purity, purification.
2 A stench, a stink.
3 Civet.
E.
पू to be pure, or पूय to stink, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-जः)
A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.)
E.
पूतिक the same, रञ्ज to colour, aff. अण्; also with the nasal retained पूतिकरञ्ज.

m. (-जः)
A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) Also पूतीक, पूतिक, पूतिकरज, पूतीकरञ्ज, or पूतिकरञ्ज.

m. (-कः)
Fetid ulceration of the ear.
E.
पूति, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.

m. (-खः)
A bivalve shell.
E.
पूतिका a potherb, and मुख face, appearance.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A sort of pine, (P. devadaru.)
E.
पूति purity, काष्ठ wood; also with कन् added पूतिकाष्ठक.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Ill-smelling.
n. (-न्धं)
Sulphur.
E.
पूति a stink, and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
Ill-smelling.
E.
पूति stinking, गन्ध smell, and इन् substituted for the final.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ill-smelling, fetid.
E.
पूति a stink, गन्ध smell, ठक् aff.

f. (-ला)
Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum halicacabum.)
E.
पूति stink, तैल oil.

f. (-का)
A variety of the common citron, (Citrus medica.)
E.
पूति stinking, and पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
Fetid exhalation from the nostrils.
E.
पूति, and नस्य nostril.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Psoralea corilifolia.)
E.
पूति stinking, and फल fruit.

f. (-ली)
A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
पूति stink, फल fruit.

n. (-सं)
Dead or decayed flesh.
E.
पूति, and मांस flesh.

m. (-तः)
The Bel, (Ægle marmelos.)
2 Foul air.
E.
पूति a stink, and वात wind.

m. (-क्षः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
पूति a foul smell, and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-जा)
The pole or civet-cat.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The musk deer.
2 An insect with a fetid smell, the winged bug.
E.
पूति a stench, and अण्ड the testicle or any egg.
